title: Kerala heavy rains LIVE: Revenue Minister calls meeting for rescue operations
summary: A red alert has been issued for eight districts in Kerala, while an orange alert has been issued in three districts and Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam and Alappuzha have been placed under a yellow alert

title: Kerala government to come up with draft framework for granting industry status to Malayalam cinema
summary: “Granting industry status and completing the initial formalities is part of the 100-day action plan of the UDF government,” Minister for Cinema P.C. Vishnunadh told The Hindu

title: Civic official suspended for absence from SIR duty in Palghar
summary: The Palghar administration, in a release, said that Gopal Chaudhari, group education officer of the Vasai Panchayat Samiti, repeatedly failed to perform his designated tasks for the 132-Nalasopara constituency.

title: PM Modi in Andhra LIVE: ASR International Airport at Bhogapuram to be inaugurated
summary: Andhra Pradesh gets its first greenfield international airport since the 2014 bifurcation, along with projects worth over ₹17,900 crore that the Prime Minister will dedicate and lay foundation stones for

title: Government to question Meta global team on issues around algorithmic bias, role in public order
summary: The government earlier this week summoned a top Meta executive after Modi’s recent post addressing India’s youth and promising stringent measures against paper leaks was briefly restricted on Facebook.

title: High Court directs Chief Secretary to constitute high-level committee to undertake comprehensive review of the functioning of DVAC
summary: The committee, to be headed by the Chief Secretary himself, will review how the DVAC functions, especially with reference to aspects such as leadership and institutional governance, strengthening of institutional capacity, investigation, and preventive vigilance, administrative reforms, and technology and public interface

title: Kerala prepares disaster-prevention measures as heavy rains lash State
summary: Disaster prevention activities will be coordinated by the Revenue Minister A.P. Anilkumar

title: IMD upgrades rain alert to red for 8 districts in Kerala after intense overnight rains
summary: Extremely heavy rainfall is likely over the next 24 hours in Idukki, Kottayam, Pathanamthitta, Malappuram, Kozhikode, Wayanad, Kannur and Kasaragod
